observed_failures.observed: A read-only source-state probe used a direct foreach-to-pipeline form that PowerShell rejected before execution.
observed_failures.recovery: Materialize the bounded array before piping it to JSON.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell iteration output before downstream pipelines.

observed_failures.observed: A baton read used Measure-Object -Line and mistook 408 nonempty lines for the 865-line physical file.
observed_failures.recovery: Use the exact UTF-8 line array Count and read through EOF.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Distinguish physical line count from nonempty-line metrics.

observed_failures.observed: A combined required-skill read exceeded the useful output budget and hid later references.
observed_failures.recovery: Read each exact skill and required reference separately through EOF.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Bound skill reads by file and verify every exact companion.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed a JSON auth schema although the installed companion is Markdown.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate the exact reference directory and read auth-permission-state-schema.md.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve installed reference names before reading.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed roster-schema.md rather than roster-state-schema.md.
observed_failures.recovery: Enumerate and read the exact roster-state-schema.md companion.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve schema filenames from the skill directory.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed method-flow-state-schema.md rather than schema.md.
observed_failures.recovery: Read the exact schema.md named by the skill.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Follow the complete skill's exact reference name.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only lookup guessed tool-selection-schema.md rather than catalogue-schema.md.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Enumerate referenced schema files before access.

observed_failures.observed: A PowerShell all-title novelty implementation exceeded its wrapper and left no attributable complete audit.
observed_failures.recovery: Terminate only the owned probe and run an in-memory Python token audit.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use linear in-memory Python for thousands of title comparisons.

observed_failures.observed: The first Python novelty diagnostic computed results but failed while emitting Māori text through CP1252.
observed_failures.recovery: Emit ASCII-safe JSON or pin UTF-8 before Unicode diagnostics.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Pin UTF-8 before emitting proposal or Māori text.

observed_failures.observed: A proposed temporary-file Git-blob hash command was rejected before state change.
observed_failures.recovery: Hash immutable Git stdout and the checkout directly without a temporary file.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Prefer direct immutable blob bytes for read-only hash evidence.

observed_failures.observed: A read-only ripgrep call passed a literal wildcard path that Windows did not expand.
observed_failures.recovery: Search the exact directory root with a -g filename filter.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Use ripgrep globs through -g on Windows.

observed_failures.observed: A combined post-checkout audit exceeded its wrapper and left a long status process without attributable complete output.
observed_failures.recovery: Terminate only the owned process and split head, branch, tracked, index, and untracked probes.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Split large-worktree Git state checks into scalar calls.

observed_failures.observed: A four-query long official-source search exceeded the useful output window and provided no complete attributable source set.
observed_failures.recovery: Repeat two official-domain queries at a time with short output and retain only successfully resolved primary pages.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Bound web-source discovery by query count and response length.

observed_failures.observed: A semantic cleanup patch combined ASCII changes with a Unicode-rendered heading context and was rejected without changing the file.
observed_failures.recovery: Apply ASCII-stable hunks separately and overwrite the generated heading through a bounded current block.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not combine independent ASCII edits with Unicode-sensitive patch anchors.

observed_failures.observed: The ordinary porcelain commit wrapper returned without attributable output and an immediate head read still showed the source; a later durable-state audit found the exact single-parent x1 commit had completed.
observed_failures.recovery: Keep the durable commit, rewrite no history, verify its parent and tree, and use one narrow x1-only repair commit for later lifecycle evidence.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: After an unattributed mutating wrapper, audit branch HEAD, parent, tree, index, worktree, and processes before any retry or alternate commit path.

observed_failures.observed: A warm x1 builder rerun encountered the newly durable x1 commit and correctly refused because its original guard allowed only the exact source head.
observed_failures.recovery: Extend the guard only for a single source-descendant x1-only repair commit, keep source receipts anchored to the immutable Caelen final, and reject any x2 or broader history.
observed_failures.recurrence_guard: Lifecycle-aware builders must distinguish immutable source identity from the current bounded x1 repair head.
